neighbours.label: the word right after a work/activity verb naming what one is busy with ('work on', 'go about my business', 'doing business')
fire: After dropping out of school she had to work on the family farm every summer.
Nobody noticed me, so I decided to just go about my business quietly.
The two writers began work on the anthology long before it was published.
Most mornings he simply goes about his business without saying a word.
I am responsible for doing business with people I have never met.
The girls conducted their business a few yards away from the tent.
We spent the whole winter working on the new manuscript together.
What role does theory play in the daily work of a designer?
quiet: After dropping out of school she moved to the city with her cousin.
Nobody noticed me, so I decided to sit in the corner quietly.
The two writers had long argued before the anthology was published.
Most mornings he simply drinks his coffee without saying a word.
I am responsible for paying the rent to people I have never met.
The girls set up their tent a few yards away from the lake.
We spent the whole winter reading old novels together.
What role does theory play in the life of a designer?

notes: Weak pole (max 4.75). Card peaks: ' on' after work, ' business' after go about/doing/conducted, 'of' after daily work.
